craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of stated proof — design inference through lacunae; gaps sung as gaps; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (terminal doctrine words; owner verdict required). Variety-marks-wisdom; pots-prove; use-intent close. Rejected: (a) means→intends soften → killed: resolve kept. Read aloud: A-mid THE-var-ied … MEANS each-FORM for-USE.

lines: Amid the varied, mind alone stands clear —
pots prove it: the wise Maker means each form for use.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vicitre buddhimāneva ghaṭādiṣviva lakṣyate kartā vijño vicitraitadupayogābhisaṃdhimān

reads_against.argmap: How is the maker marked? → Variety marks the wise maker: resolved on varied use, visible among pots.
c1_essence: Bodies bespeak a conscious maker, like pots: the design inference stated through lacunae (vv1-2).
Variety marks wisdom; matter can't arrange; makers proved prove the Lord — answering neither-potter-nor-Lord with conscious-only pervasion shown (vv5-9).
